title: Who is Jiyan? Wuthering Waves
sources: https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com official news 795 'Profile Reveal: General of the Midnight Rangers — Jiyan': leader of the Midnight Rangers; conjures a powerful Qingloong from the winds; Attribute Aero, 5 stars, affiliation Jinzhou

scenes.narration: He bends the wind itself, and shapes it into a dragon. This is Jiyan, General of the Midnight Rangers, in Wuthering Waves.
Before he was a general, he was an army medic, born into a medical family. He still carries a gourd-shaped pill case for first aid.
Someone once saw him handing out candy from it to kids. Now there's a myth that the gourd has infinite space inside.
Funny thing: he was never great with a lance. But during a devastating siege, the winds converged and became the lance he wields today.
He also runs a very tight ship. Dust on the window sills? Clean it up. Third row, fourth from the left: your vambrace is off-center.
Yet after every battle, he plants new seeds in Knell Square, where the flowers honor the fallen. He's a five-star Aero Resonator.
So, would you survive Jiyan's inspection? Tell me in the comments.
